tn.name: Tennessee (statewide)
tn.bounds: Every Tennessee waterfowl season is statewide (the Southeast Crane Zone applies to sandhill cranes only).
tn.note: One zone. WMAs and refuges set their own days, hours and draw hunts.

seasonsNote: Every waterfowl season is statewide. WMA waterfowl hunting is by permit, draw, tier blinds or the area’s own days and hours.

seasons.label: Teal and wood ducks — September
seasons.note: No more than 2 wood ducks in the 6.

seasons.label: Canada geese — regular
seasons.note: White-fronted geese Nov 28–29 and Dec 5 – Feb 14; brant with the Canada goose dates.

seasons.label: Light geese
seasons.note: Blue, snow and Ross’s geese (standard federal rules). Conservation Season Feb 15 – Mar 31, 2027 with a free permit: no limit, unplugged guns, electronic calls, to 30 minutes after sunset.

seasons.label: Veterans and active military waterfowl days

bags.detail: Six ducks, inside which the limits below apply. Possession three times the daily limit (1× on opening day, 2× on the second day).
Youths 6–16 with a non-hunting adult 21+; coots, gallinules, ducks, mergansers and geese.
Veterans and active-duty military, National Guard and Reserves.

duckSublimits.note: their own limit; no more than 2 hooded

rules.d: One-half hour before sunrise to sunset (federal rule); some WMAs end earlier (South Fork and Horns Bluff at 3 p.m.).
No loose shot or shells other than federally approved non-toxic shot while hunting waterfowl, sandhill cranes, coots, gallinules and Virginia and sora rails.
No more than 3 shells (except crows, and light geese in the Conservation Season).

WMAs marked “WF” need an annual or 1-day Small Game and Waterfowl Permit (Sportsman’s licences exempt). Many WMAs hunt from tier blinds (Tier 1 season-long draw, Tier 2 periodic draw, Tier 4 first come) or by draw; temporary blinds and decoys at least 200 yards from tier blinds. Some WMAs close from two hours after shooting ends until 4 a.m. during the late duck season.

rules.t: South Fork and Horns Bluff refuges
rules.d: Saturdays and Sundays only during the November–February duck season; hunting ends at 3 p.m. (sunset on the last day); closed to other access Nov 15 – Feb 15. Amber on the map.
No hunting on public land or water within 100 yards of a visible dwelling without the owner’s permission.
Youth (6–16): Feb 6 and 13, 2027. Veterans and active military: Feb 7 and 14, 2027. WMAs with special closing times are open all day on youth days.
Leave the head or one fully feathered wing on until you get home, and tag birds left with anyone else (federal rules).

licences.d: Resident Hunting and Fishing Combination licence, or Sportsman’s; non-resident Annual Hunt – Small Game/Waterfowl $110 (or 7-day $61).
$37 with the combination licence (Sportsman’s and Lifetime exempt).

geometryNote: Geometry: TWRA lands and boating and fishing access sites; USGS NHD (water; streams from the NHD small-scale layer) and GNIS; USFWS (refuge units; NWI marsh); Census TIGER (outline, county subdivisions, borders); OpenStreetMap (roads). One statewide zone. No tides.
